hero.label: Join The Team
hero.headline: Come work with us.
hero.subtext: MDP Coffee House has been built by people who show up — every morning, at every counter, in every city. If you think you have something to bring to this team, we'd love to hear from you.

why.title: Training Academy
why.body: Every MDP team member goes through our in-house Training Academy in Bengaluru. We don't just hire people — we build Coffee Masters.

why.title: Room to Grow
why.body: From outlet staff to supervisors to area managers — most of our leadership started on the counter. We promote from within.

why.title: 400+ Strong
why.body: Over four hundred people across India wake up every morning and come to work at MDP. You'd be joining a team that takes pride in what it does.

openings.experience: 1–2 years preferred. Freshers considered for a trainee position.
openings.qualification: Minimum 7th Standard. Not a barrier for experienced candidates.
openings.skills: Knowledge of preparing coffee, tea, and other hot beverages.

openings.qualification: SSLC. Not a barrier for experienced candidates.
openings.skills: Comprehensive knowledge of coffee and tea counter operations — preparing beverages, managing billing, leading the team, and maintaining a strong manpower network.

Supplier evaluation, price negotiation, purchase orders and vendor tracking, food safety compliance, inventory monitoring, and coordination with warehouse and finance teams. Proficiency in ERP systems and advanced Excel.

form.headline: Send us an open application.
form.subtext: Don't see the right fit above? If you think you have something else to bring to this team, we'd still love to hear from you. We read every message.
